title: Layer Sensitivity Analysis for Activation-Based Jailbreak Detection

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Choosing the right layer substantially improves detection accuracy and reduces compute. A cross-model pattern would enable a principled heuristic for deploying probes. Clear practical impact for monitoring systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probing at different layers is standard ML. Extracting hidden states at every 4th layer is straightforward with HuggingFace. Two models (Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B) on medium compute is feasible. Well within beginner scope.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Systematic sweep across layers on 2 models. Clear deliverable: AUROC vs. layer depth plot. Single experiment type repeated across layers. Fits comfortably in 30 hours.
